create_Size_dataclass: create a Size dataclass instance with n_layers, emb_size, n_heads, d_head, batch_size, lr, and model_parallel
access_Size_ffn_size_property: access the ffn_size property on a Size instance to get 4 times the embedding size
lookup_MODEL_SIZES: lookup a model configuration by name from the MODEL_SIZES dictionary such as 13b or 175b
use_ComputeEnvs_enum: use the ComputeEnvs enum to reference AWS, AZURE, FAIR, or RSC compute environments
access_VALID_SUBSETS: access the VALID_SUBSETS list to get available dataset names like CommonCrawl or Wikipedia_en
